text:
devon: Quick follow-up thread from today's GPU capacity postmortem. I consolidated overlapping action items into a single incident board to avoid duplicated work. Need owners, ETAs, and blockers.

anika: drop the board link pls?

devon: https://rwd.internal/infra/incident-board/incident-ops-999 — I merged two quota tickets into #7501.

sana: I can own quota liaison with cloud. Will list exact GPU SKU + fallback SKUs by EOD tomorrow.

lee: I'll validate traffic sims and whether the autoscaler assumptions held. Preliminary: two different burst patterns — frequent short bursts (~30s) and long sustained spikes (2-4h). Need both handled.

marta: Monitoring gap was obvious. We had only a delta-based headroom metric; let's add a latency-percentile driven headroom and a per-zone free-GPU gauge.

anika: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: move from fixed percentage headroom to adaptive target based on p95 latency and a rolling window. Patch sketch below: 
```
scaler:
  mode: adaptive
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  window_seconds: 300
  target_headroom_pct: 20
  headroom_bounds: [8, 35]
  scale_down_cooldown: 180
  max_burst_instances: 3
  zone_awareness: true
```

lee: zone_awareness + max_burst_instances is critical — avoids cross-zone preemption storms. I'll add a sim to the load test suite. ETA for sim results: Thursday.

sana: quota timeline: I'll submit requests for A100/NVIDIA-quantized-compatible variants tomorrow AM. Cloud typically responds in 48-96h. Mark #7501 as blocked until approval.

devon: noted. ops-bot, create subtasks for quota (#7501), scheduler (#7502), monitoring/runbook (#7503). Assign: sana, anika, marta.

ops-bot: created tasks: #7501 (quota request) assigned to sana, #7502 (scheduler tuning) assigned to anika, #7503 (monitoring & runbook) assigned to marta. ETA fields empty.

marta: runbook priorities: immediate mitigations, verification steps, and rollback plan. Draft immediate checklist: 1) enable CPU-fallback route, 2) reduce max-gen-length to 60 tokens, 3) enforce KV cache for repeated prompts, 4) temporarily increase reserved pool if quota allows. Keep it concise.

lee: I'll add smoke checks for the scheduler PRs: one-line verification for each change. Examples: "deploy -> run 100 concurrent short bursts -> p95 latency < baseline*1.3". Will include in PRs.

anika: scheduling the rollout: small canary in one zone, 1h observation, then region-wide. If churn > 4/min during canary, auto-roll back.

sana: adding blocker tag "quota-pending" to #7501 and calendar: we should have a twice-weekly 10-min status until quotas clear.

devon: good. ops-bot please add recurring check-in on Mondays and Thursdays for 3 weeks.

ops-bot: Recurring check created: Mondays & Thursdays 09:30 for 3 weeks. Calendar invites sent to participants.

marta: alerting changes: add alert when effective_headroom_pct < 12% for 15m, and an anomaly rule for sustained pod churn > 6/min for 5m. Also add dashboard panel for per-zone available GPUs.

lee: ETA roundup: scheduler PR + tests by Wed, monitoring PR by Fri, quota submitted by Sana tomorrow. Can we aim for retro/verification 2 weeks after scheduler deploy?

devon: yes — retro in 2 weeks to validate recurrence. Also please add 1-line rollback and verification in each PR.

sana: will post quota request ID in the board when submitted.

anika: I'll open #7502 PR draft tonight with config and changelog.

marta: pushing runbook draft to docs repo by Thu.

devon: thanks everyone. We'll track progress in #7501-#7503 and use the recurring checks until quotas and monitors are green. Closing thread for now — ping in the board if anything changes. :fistbump:
